journey.name: import preview friend count
journey.description: Precondition: the import preview is open for a disposable Ring identity that follows exactly one other profile. Repeat with an identity that follows two or more profiles. The count uses the language's plural rules, so also repeat in Russian (Settings > General > Language).

actions.action: Verify the friend count in the import preview reads "1 friend"
Open the import preview for an identity that follows several profiles and verify the count reads "N friends"
Switch the app language to Russian, open the import preview for one follow and verify the count reads "1 друг"
Verify the count for 2 to 4 follows ends in "друга" and for 5 or more ends in "друзей"
